name: Lawrence Lorot
bio: Lawrence gave up a promising running career to chase a cycling dream. Two years later he is one of the most exciting talents in East African cycling.

name: Xaverine Nirere
bio: A pure climber from the hills above Musanze, Xaverine came to cycling through the Rwandan development system and has been a mainstay of the women's squad since.

name: Samuel Niyonkuru
bio: One of the squad's most experienced riders and a steady presence on the front in long gravel stages.

name: Eyerusalem Haftu
bio: Ethiopian all-rounder with a distance running background, now racing across road and gravel for the women's squad.

name: Stanley Ngugi
bio: Kenya's fastest finisher in the squad, based at AMANI House in Iten.

name: Claudette Nyirarukundo
bio: Came through the Black Mamba Development Squad and stepped up to the women's elite roster for the 2026 season.

name: Dan Kiptala
bio: A workhorse of the men's squad and one of the first riders to live full time at AMANI House.

name: Merhawit Hadush
bio: Eritrean rouleur, the newest addition to the women's elite squad.

name: Amos Kirui
bio: U23 prospect based at AMANI House, one of the development squad's strongest climbers.
